small_guidance: The conv_transpose3d_kernel is at 81.5% memory throughput but only 32.97% occupancy due to 100 registers/thread. Reduce register pressure by shrinking BLOCK_OC*BLOCK_SPATIAL tiles (try BLOCK_OC=8/BLOCK_SPATIAL=128 or BLOCK_OC=16/BLOCK_SPATIAL=64 with num_warps=2) and add num_warps=2 configs to the autotune. Also fuse the BN+mean-subtract epilogue into a single Triton kernel that reads conv_out once (currently cudnn BN + custom kernel re-reads); fold BN affine (gamma/beta with running stats) into scale/shift constants computed once.
large_guidance: Redesign as a gather-style conv_transpose3d using the equivalent forward-conv-on-dilated-input formulation: parallelize over (N, OC_tile, OD*OH*OW_tile) with each program computing a GEMM of shape [BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SP] = W[ic,oc,k]^T @ X_gathered[ic,k,sp], using tl.dot with BLOCK_K spanning IC*KD*KH*KW. This raises arithmetic intensity, lets registers hold a small accumulator, and exploits tensor cores. Use channels_last layout for input/output so the IC axis is contiguous for K-dim coalesced loads. Fuse the BatchNorm (folded scale/shift from running stats+gamma+beta) and the per-(N,OC) spatial-mean subtraction into the kernel epilogue via a two-pass scheme: pass 1 writes (scale*x+shift) and accumulates per-(N,OC) sum; pass 2 subtracts mean. This eliminates the cudnn BN launch and the extra read/write pass entirely.
